title: PIRATES OF THE CARIBBEAN AT WORLDS END
description:
Piratas do Caribe: No Fim do Mundo é um videogame baseado nos filmes O Baú da Morte e no Fim do Mundo, dos Piratas do Caribe , publicado pela Buena Vista Games para PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, Microsoft Windows, PSP, Nintendo DS e Wii.

Piratas do Caribe: No Fim do Mundo segue os eventos de Os Piratas do Caribe filmes de Dead Man Chest e At Worlds End com algumas missões adicionais e personagens. A localização do jogo inclui locais como Black Pearl, Flying Dutchman, Tortuga, Davy Jones Locker, Shipwreck Cove, Port Royal e uma prisão. No papel do capitão Jack Sparrow, o jogador visita vários locais para encontrar os senhores piratas e lhes contar sobre o encontro em Shipwreck Cove, exigindo que o jogador batalhe contra os senhores piratas e seus guardas ou faça favores para eles.

Perto do final do jogo, o jogador deve lutar contra o Flying Dutchman como Will e Jack pelo Dead Mans Chest. A batalha termina com Will matando Davy Jones e ficando para trás enquanto Jack retorna ao Pérola Negra. No Pearl, o jogador tem que defender o navio contra o Endeavour e Lord Cutler Beckett até que o holandês volte sob o comando de Will e destrua o Endeavour, matando Beckett. Após a batalha, Barbossa tem outro motim contra Jack. Jack mais tarde encontra Black Bart junto com Scarlett e Giselle.
description_en:
Pirates of the Caribbean: Worlds End is a video game based on the films Dead Mans Chest and Worlds End, published by Buena Vista Games for PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, Microsoft Windows, PSP, Nintendo DS and Wii.

Pirates of the Caribbean: At Worlds End follows the events of The Pirates of the Caribbean films Dead Man Chest and At Worlds End with some additional missions and characters. The games location includes locations such as Black Pearl, Flying Dutchman, Tortuga, Davy Jones Locker, Shipwreck Cove, Port Royal, and a prison. Playing as Captain Jack Sparrow, the player visits various locations to find the pirate lords and tell them about the encounter at Shipwreck Cove, requiring the player to battle the pirate lords and their guards or do favors for them.

Near the end of the game, the player must fight the Flying Dutchman as Will and Jack for the Dead Mans Chest. The battle ends with Will killing Davy Jones and staying behind while Jack returns to the Black Pearl. On the Pearl, the player has to defend the ship against the Endeavor and Lord Cutler Beckett until the Dutchman returns under Wills command and destroys the Endeavour, killing Beckett. After the battle, Barbossa has another mutiny against Jack. Jack later encounters Black Bart along with Scarlett and Giselle.

La ubicación del juego incluye lugares como Black Pearl, Flying Dutchman, Tortuga, Davy Jones Locker, Shipwreck Cove, Port Royal y una prisión. Jugando como el Capitán Jack Sparrow, el jugador visita varios lugares para encontrar a los señores piratas y contarles sobre el encuentro en Shipwreck Cove, lo que requiere que el jugador luche contra los señores piratas y sus guardias o les haga favores.

Cerca del final del juego, el jugador debe luchar contra el Holandés Errante como Will y Jack por el Cofre del Hombre Muerto. La batalla termina cuando Will mata a Davy Jones y se queda atrás mientras Jack regresa al Perla Negra. En el Pearl, el jugador tiene que defender el barco contra el Endeavour y Lord Cutler Beckett hasta que el holandés regrese bajo el mando de Will y destruya el Endeavour, matando a Beckett. Después de la batalla, Barbossa se rebela contra Jack. Más tarde, Jack se encuentra con Black Bart junto con Scarlett y Giselle.
